quest.title: Reminiscence of Seirai
quest.description: You uncover a strange picture on Seirai Island...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x15000

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: You're back. How's it going? Did you manage to get those pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Wonderful. Please, let me see them...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Um... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Ahaha! I can't tell where these places are at all...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: It does seem that those three locations have changed a lot since our family left.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: I wonder if Miss Fujiwara Toshiko will be able to recognize them.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Well, actually... I doubt it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's also from Seirai Island?

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: More accurately, she's in the same boat as me — our ancestors both lived there.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Actually, there's a lot of us here in Inazuma City whose ancestors were once natives of the island, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So why did you all move away?

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: I don't really remember anymore... It was a very long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: I think it might have been the crazy storms, or to prevent smuggling and illegal border crossings...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, the Shogunate arranged for the inhabitants of the island to come to Narukami Island.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Well, that's neither here nor there. This is for you. Take it as thanks for running this errand for me.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: *sigh* Ah, I do wish that I could go to Seirai Island in person sometime...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: But I've got all this business to take care of...

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Hmm, this is quite the headache...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you know anything about this map...

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Judging by the topography, I'd say that this is some place on Seirai Island...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How could you tell?

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: The Guild has commissioned several expeditions to Seirai Island in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: The adventurers who accepted those commissions would bring us intel on the island in the form of reports.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, manpower issues have prevented us from launching large-scale expeditions, so we're stuck sending a few adventurers at a time to explore the area.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that this limits the extent to which I can continue helping you to analyze this map.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: However, I do know someone who might have more to do with Seirai Island than me.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: His name's Oda Tarou. I've heard that his ancestors used to live on Seirai Island before migrating here for various reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, he did come to the Guild some time back to hire some adventurers who would accompany him to Seirai Island to see the place...

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: You can ask him about this map. With any luck, he might know something about it.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I find someone who'll accompany me back there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you know anything about this map...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Are you... an adventurer with the Guild? Can they finally spare the people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, I'm just a passing traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Hmm, fine, then... What's this map you spoke of?

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Now, let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Th—This! Could it be...

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Haha, is it really? I just guessed.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Although my ancestors once lived on Seirai Island, that was a very long time ago now.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: By the time we came to my generation, we no longer had any impression of our old home.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: All we have left in the house to remind us of it are three landscape paintings of the island.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So why do you want to go back?

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Well... It is still my "hometown," is it not?

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: I feel like... I have to go see it no matter what.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Unfortunately, I'm pretty busy running my business at the moment, so I haven't the time to go.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Additionally, I had some trouble finding adventurers willing to escort me to Seirai Island...

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: So I went with Option B: putting up a commission at the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Hopefully, some adventurers can help me go to Seirai Island, find the three places shown in those paintings, take a few pictures with a Kamera, and bring those pictures back to me.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: But no one's picked up that commission thus far...

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: W—Would you really? That would be amazing!

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: As for payment, you need not worry. I will have it ready for you for sure.

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Well then, Traveler, I'll be counting on you. Including the map you brought, that would make four locations to take pictures of...

response.speaker: Oda Tarou
response.text: Well then, Traveler, please head to these four locations and snap a picture of each of them for me.

choices.text: I can go there for you.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Seirai Island... How I wish I could see you for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: But where will I find the time...
